summary.business_type: B2B Industrial Equipment Manufacturer & Exporter (Portable Light Pole Lifter)
top_findings: Brand Entity & Domain Mismatch: Domain is velolev.org but brand identity is exclusively volvet across all pages, titles, logos, and schemas without entity aliasing or sameAs linkage.
Double Redirect Chain on Bare Domain: http://velolev.org -> 308 -> https://velolev.org/ -> 308 -> https://www.velolev.org/ (2 hops).
Missing /sitemap.xml: Default /sitemap.xml returns HTTP 404; only /sitemap-index.xml is served, without a server redirect.
Client-side Meta-Refresh (HTTP 200) on Legacy Routes: /equipment/ and /pricing-plan/ serve HTML 200 with meta-refresh rather than server-side HTTP 308 redirects.
Unoptimized Heavy Image Payloads: Reference jobsite JPEG images on homepage reach 896 KB each (2.55 MB total for 3 thumbnails), lacking WebP/AVIF compression.
quick_wins: Add 308 redirect rules in vercel.json for /sitemap.xml -> /sitemap-index.xml, /equipment/ -> /products/light-pole-jack/, and /pricing-plan/ -> /quote/.
Compress reference images to WebP/AVIF (680x380 px) to save 2.4 MB (94% payload reduction) on the homepage.
Shorten 37 titles (>65 chars) and 47 meta descriptions (>160 chars) to prevent Google SERP truncation.
Fix H1 typography spacing glitches (e.g., 'Light pole lifting.Made portable.' -> 'Light pole lifting. Made portable.').

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Fast Edge serving on Vercel with HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 support
TLS 1.3 encryption with valid Let's Encrypt certificate (88 days remaining)
HSTS enabled with strict preload requirements (max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload)
Security headers: nosniff, SAMEORIGIN, strict-origin-when-cross-origin, Permissions-Policy
Clean canonical URLs across all 143 sitemap pages (100% self-referencing matches)
robots.txt explicitly permits all major search bots and AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, etc.)
Clean 404 handling without soft-404 traps

findings.title: Double Redirect Chain on Bare HTTP Domain
findings.description: http://velolev.org performs a 308 redirect to https://velolev.org/, which then executes a second 308 redirect to https://www.velolev.org/. Double hops dilute link equity and waste crawl budget.
findings.recommendation: Update Vercel domain routing or middleware so http://velolev.org redirects directly to https://www.velolev.org/ in a single 308 hop.

findings.title: Standard /sitemap.xml Returns HTTP 404
findings.description: Many crawlers, third-party SEO auditing tools, and search bots query /sitemap.xml by default. Currently, https://www.velolev.org/sitemap.xml returns HTTP 404, while the valid index is at /sitemap-index.xml.
findings.recommendation: Add a permanent redirect rule in vercel.json from /sitemap.xml to /sitemap-index.xml.

findings.title: Legacy Routes Use HTTP 200 Client Meta-Refresh Instead of Server Redirects
findings.description: Paths /equipment/ and /pricing-plan/ return HTTP 200 with <meta http-equiv='refresh'> and <meta name='robots' content='noindex'>. Search engines may delay deindexing and crawling of the true destination.
findings.recommendation: Configure permanent HTTP 308 redirects in vercel.json for /equipment/ -> /products/light-pole-jack/ and /pricing-plan/ -> /quote/.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP) Header
findings.description: The server does not transmit a Content-Security-Policy header, leaving an opening for potential script injection or framing risks.
findings.recommendation: Define an appropriate CSP header within vercel.json headers configuration.

findings.title: Hardcoded Static lastmod Timestamps in Sitemap
findings.description: All 143 entries in sitemap-0.xml carry the identical static date '2026-10-28T00:00:00.000Z', preventing search engines from recognizing true incremental article updates.
findings.recommendation: Dynamically derive lastmod in astro.config.mjs serialize hook using article publish/update metadata.

categories.name: Content Quality & E-E-A-T
what_works: Exceptional engineering rigor: F001-F031 physical fact cards with clear distinction between confirmed specs and pending field validation
Explicit negative scope boundaries protecting customer safety (strict 12 m height and 300 kg load limits)
Comprehensive E-E-A-T institutional pages: About Us, Editorial Policy, Privacy Notice, Terms
High topical depth in English pillar articles (1,500 - 3,500 words with calculation formulas and crane cost comparisons)

findings.title: Critical Brand Entity & Domain Disconnect (velolev.org vs volvet)
findings.description: The domain is velolev.org, yet the brand is exclusively identified as 'volvet' across all page titles, logos, schemas, and body copy. There is zero on-page or schema explanation of the relationship between velolev and volvet.
findings.recommendation: Add clear corporate brand entity linkage: explain on /about-us/ that volvet is the brand/trademark hosted at velolev.org, add sameAs and alternateName properties in Organization schema, or align domain branding.

findings.title: Multilingual Asymmetry (35 English Pages vs 18 in Other Locales)
findings.description: English offers 35 pages including deep equipment configurations and comparison guides. In contrast, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Vietnamese, Thai, and Indonesian only have 18 pages each, leaving 17 key articles unlocalized.
findings.recommendation: Translate the 5 configuration pages and high-performing guide articles into the 6 supported international target markets.

findings.title: Thin Content Signals in Thai (/th/) Pages
findings.description: 14 pages in the Thai (/th/) subdirectory extract to under 250 words, partly due to lack of space delimiters in Thai and brief translated copy, posing a potential low-quality content risk in regional SERPs.
findings.recommendation: Enrich Thai technical guides with fuller localization and descriptive engineering vocabulary.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: 100% of 143 pages have title tags and meta descriptions
100% of 143 pages follow the single H1 hierarchy standard
Consistent brand suffix appending (' | volvet') on all titles
Clean URL structure with trailing slashes and descriptive lowercase slugs
Zero orphan pages: all 143 sitemap pages are discoverable through internal links

findings.title: 37 Title Tags Exceed 65 Characters (SERP Truncation)
findings.description: 37 pages carry titles between 66 and 82 characters (e.g. 'M16–M22 4-Bolt Portable Light Pole Lifter Configuration (180–260 mm Span) | volvet' - 82 chars), resulting in truncated display snippets in Google search results.
findings.recommendation: Trim titles to 55-60 characters while front-loading core target keywords (e.g., 'M16–M22 Pole Lifter Configuration (180–260mm) | volvet').

findings.title: 47 Meta Descriptions Exceed 160 Characters
findings.description: 47 pages have descriptions ranging from 161 to 225 characters (e.g., /es/equipment/ at 225 chars), causing search engines to truncate sentences mid-phrase.
findings.recommendation: Condense descriptions to 140-155 characters with clear B2B procurement calls-to-action.

findings.title: Punctuation and Typography Spacing Glitches in H1 Tags
findings.description: Multiple H1 headings lack spacing after sentence-terminating periods, such as 'Light pole lifting.Made portable.' and 'Calculate a scenario.Keep the assumptions.'. Additionally, 'lightpole' is written as a single compound word on the equipment page.
findings.recommendation: Ensure proper spacing after periods ('Light pole lifting. Made portable.') and use standard terminology ('light pole').

categories.name: Schema & Structured Data
what_works: 100% schema deployment across all 143 pages with 0 JSON syntax errors
Proper deployment of Organization, WebSite, BreadcrumbList, Product, TechArticle, and FAQPage
Rich PropertyValue specification cards embedded in Product schema

findings.title: Product Schema Missing 'offers' and Product Identifiers
findings.description: Product schema on configuration pages omits the 'offers' property, triggering Google Rich Result warnings in Search Console. It also lacks 'sku' and 'mpn'.
findings.recommendation: Include an Offer object with availability ('https://schema.org/InStock') and priceSpecification or price on request, plus an MPN/SKU identifier.

findings.title: Organization Schema Lacks sameAs Entity Links & Physical Address
findings.description: Organization schema lists name, description, logo, and contactPoint, but lacks sameAs links to official social profiles, registries, and physical company address.
findings.recommendation: Add sameAs links and PostalAddress in Organization schema to solidify Google Knowledge Graph entity mapping.

findings.title: TechArticle Schema Omits Explicit Author Object
findings.description: Guide pages deploy TechArticle schema without an explicit Person or Organization author entity.
findings.recommendation: Add author: {'@type': 'Organization', 'name': 'volvet Technical Engineering Team'} to TechArticle schema.

categories.name: Performance (Core Web Vitals)
what_works: Zero-JS / minimal-JS static architecture with zero framework client hydration overhead
Tiny external CSS payload (31.5 KB total across 2 files)
Web font (/fonts/geologica-latin.woff2 - 24.6 KB) preloaded with crossorigin
Above-the-fold hero image preloaded with fetchpriority='high'
Sub-150ms TTFB on Vercel Global Edge Network

findings.title: Heavy Uncompressed Reference Images (2.55 MB on Homepage)
findings.description: Three reference jobsite photos on the homepage are served as uncompressed JPEGs: jobsite-rural-solar-street-light.jpg (897 KB), jobsite-parking-lot-tight-space.jpg (834 KB), jobsite-sidewalk-municipal-road.jpg (819 KB). Total image payload is 2.55 MB for 3 thumbnail cards.
findings.recommendation: Convert all content images to WebP/AVIF format and scale them to their display dimensions (680x380 px at 80% quality), reducing file size from 850 KB to ~35 KB per image (94% savings).

findings.title: Hero Image Served as 196 KB PNG Without Modern Format Variants
findings.description: The hero cutout image (/images/product/portable-pole-lifter-hero-cutout.png) is a 195.7 KB PNG file without WebP/AVIF fallback or picture srcset element.
findings.recommendation: Provide WebP/AVIF version with alpha channel to cut hero payload down to ~45 KB.

categories.name: AI Search & GEO Readiness
what_works: llms.txt (6.8 KB) and llms-full.txt (59.3 KB) deployed and fully accessible at domain root
robots.txt explicitly allows GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Bytespider, and OAI-SearchBot
Fully server-rendered content (911 words on homepage) accessible without headless browser execution
Systematic F001-F031 physical fact cards providing grounded engineering data for LLM citation

findings.title: llms.txt Formatting Hygiene Warnings
findings.description: llms.txt includes parameter specifications under H2 headings rather than link lists [Title](URL) as proposed in llmstxt.org v2, producing 11 item-without-link parser notes.
findings.recommendation: Refactor llms.txt so general specifications precede the first H2, and H2 sections consist strictly of markdown links to published articles and data sheets.

findings.title: Well-Known AI Discovery Files Absent
findings.recommendation: Optionally deploy ai-catalog.json and agent-card.json to advertise machine-readable endpoints.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Descriptive, keyword-rich alt text on 100% of content photos
Explicit width and height HTML attributes preventing Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS)
Native loading='lazy' attribute configured on all below-the-fold images

findings.title: Tracking / Spacer 1x1 Base64 GIF Lacks Alt Tag
findings.description: Base64 1x1 spacer GIF present across all pages lacks alt='' attribute or role='presentation', creating an accessibility/SEO audit warning.
findings.recommendation: Add alt='' or aria-hidden='true' to the spacer image element.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes & Infrastructure Routing
items: Fix bare domain HTTP redirect chain in Vercel to ensure single-hop http://velolev.org -> https://www.velolev.org/.
Add corporate entity clarification on /about-us/ and Organization schema linking the velolev.org domain with the volvet brand identity.

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Performance & Metadata Optimization
items: Batch convert and optimize all jobsite evidence images and hero PNG to WebP/AVIF, slashing ~2.4 MB from the homepage payload.
Trim 37 page titles exceeding 65 characters to 55-60 characters to eliminate Google SERP truncation.
Condense 47 meta descriptions exceeding 160 characters down to 140-155 characters with clear procurement CTAs.
Fix typography and punctuation spacing in H1 tags ('Light pole lifting. Made portable.').

phases.name: Phase 3: Schema Enrichment & International Expansion
items: Enrich Product schema with Offer / AggregateOffer RFQ details, MPN, and SKU identifiers.
Add sameAs social/corporate links and PostalAddress to Organization schema; add author entity to TechArticle schema.
Align localized URL path conventions between English and international locales (/products/ vs /equipment/).
Translate 5 equipment configuration pages into Spanish, French, Portuguese, Vietnamese, Thai, and Indonesian.

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring, Verification & AI Search Upgrades
items: Connect Google Search Console and GA4 to monitor indexation and organic query impressions.
Refactor llms.txt to comply with llmstxt.org v2 format standards.
Implement dynamic lastmod timestamps in sitemap generation linked to content file modification dates.
